question: What verdict fits storage/0x0-st-2? Its egress carries no stated price or cap, so fails-egress is not supported by egress; the seed failure was an uploads-disabled answer that the reader copy of the page does not show, and the origin answered HTTP 500 to a direct probe.
why: The record keeps fails-egress with no egress limit; a live upload probe or the operator decides between dead, fails-quota and qualifies-with-caveat (512 MiB per file, retention 30 days to 1 year by size).
